title: Woolworths Limited - proposed acquisition of Liquor Barons Dianella

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Woolworths proposed to acquire a takeaway packaged liquor licence and business which currently trades as Liquor Barons Dianella and is located at Shop 4, Dianella Plaza Shopping Centre, Dianella, Western Australia.
body_sections.Market definition: This proposed acquisition was assessed within the context of the following markets: 1. the local market for the retail sale of packaged liquor for off-premises consumption. The geographic dimension is a 3-5km radius surrounding the target retail liquor business (Market 1); 2. the Western Australian market for the wholesale supply of packaged liquor for subsequent sale in the retail market for off-premises consumption (Market 2).
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 22 January 2008, the ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition is unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets. Factors informing this conclusion included: 1. in relation to Market 1, the ACCC concluded that post-acquisition, Woolworths will be constrained by competition from Coles and a substantial number of independent bottle shops in the local area; and 2. in relation to Market 2, the ACCC considered that the relatively small increase in market share of Woolworths, as a result of the acquisition, was unlikely to significantly increase the buying power of Woolworths or substantially weaken any competing wholesaler by diminishing its buyer power.
